name: What are the main types of ADUs?

mainEntity.name: What are the main types of ADUs?

acceptedAnswer.text: ADUs can be detached (standalone backyard cottage), attached (addition to the main house), or converted from existing space (garage, basement, or attic), while JADUs are always internal conversions.
